newsitem.title: USA: First Union completes Home Financial merger.
newsitem.headline: First Union completes Home Financial merger.

text.p: First Union Corp said on Monday it had completed the acquisition of Home Financial Corp.
Under the merger agreement, First Union said it will exchange 0.2257 shares of its common stock for each share of Home Financial common stock.
The agreement was announced in June, and the company had then said it would exchange 0.2233 shares of its stock for each share of Home Financial.
A spokesman for First Union told Reuters that the merger agreement allowed for "an upward adjustment in terms".
